goals.text: Increase paid conversion from trial from 8% to 12%
Reduce involuntary churn (failed payments) by 30%
Reach 1,000 teams on annual contracts
Launch in three new countries

decisions.title: Prices are shown in the customer's local currency
No discounts on monthly plans
Annual plans are billed upfront
Annual plans can be billed quarterly

goals.text: Review a spec before any code is written
Let a team adopt the review in its pull requests without friction
Let coding agents check their own spec before they implement it
Let the person who approves decide at a glance
Keep every approval auditable
Keep the product visually simple, with more depth available on demand
Let a new person understand what the product is for and see a result within five minutes of signing in
Let many companies use the product at the same time without ever seeing each other's data
Let a company see and decide what its software does today, before anything changes it
Welcome both a company that already has software and a person who is building with an AI tool and has no code yet, each with the words and first result that fit them
Make sure every account belongs to a real person who verified a phone number
Use Speco on Speco: the product's own repository is the first company connected, so every improvement is first tried on ourselves
Connect the code of a company wherever it lives, starting with GitHub and Bitbucket, with the same reviews and the same portrait
Let anyone reach their first result at no cost, with limits that keep what the free plan spends under a ceiling we chose
Let every satisfied person bring the next one, and thank them in a way that costs us only what we decided
Know, with numbers we trust, whether the product is working before we spend to grow it
Let a company that reaches its limit pay for more room and see exactly what it pays, without ever being charged for something it did not get
Show each company, with evidence it can check, the problems the reviews caught before any code was written
Be the first place a person or an agent goes to learn what the software does today and what is left to build, with evidence anyone can check and a history of who decided each rule

decisions.title: Every review is deterministic and works offline
The tool has no runtime dependencies
A model is an optional layer and never required for a finding to exist
The review does not modify the reviewed repository
Only explicit commands write files, and only the files they announce
Simple by default, depth on demand
The product is the layer where business intent lives, for people who approve and not for people who program
The multi-tenant service is a separate layer on Postgres (Supabase) and the review engine stays dependency-free
Rules found by a model are proposals, and only a person turns them into the company's baseline
One product with two doors: a company with software, and a person with an idea and no code
Registration requires a phone number verified by SMS, so every account is a real person
Agents connected through MCP read and propose, and only a person decides
Code hosting is a provider behind one small read only interface, and a company chooses which of its repositories Speco reads
The free plan limits what a model costs us, never what is deterministic
A referral is rewarded with credits, and only after the person invited gets their first result
Product metrics are derived from what the product already records, and no figure is reported without its sample size
Payment sits behind one small interface, billing is off until the operator turns it on, and a plan change happens only after the charge is accepted
Value delivered is the problems caught before code, counted from the reviews and weighted by what the company says would have shipped
Verification of the code against an approved rule sits behind one small interface, and a rule is never described as proved unless a formal proof exists
A rule is called verified only when a recorded run of the tests that cite it passed for its current text, and an agent may draft and change rules but never approve them
